title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Night in New York City: Here’s Where to Buy Yankees Baseball Game Tickets Online
summary: Calling all KPop Demon Hunters fans! If you live in NYC, then you could get a free Rumi bobblehead at the Mariners-Yankees game in The Bronx.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

In partnership with Netflix, the New York Yankees is hosting a special KPop Demon Hunters Night . If you’re one of the first 18,000 fans to attend the Mariners-Yankees game, then you can get a limited-edition KPDH x MLB Rumi bobblehead for free.

KPop Demon Hunters Night is on Tuesday (Aug. 11) with the Seattle Mariners taking on the New York Yankees at Yankee Stadium in The Bronx, New York. First pitch is at 7:05 p.m. ET.

Shop New York Yankees Tickets at Ticketmaster

As for the bobblehead, the half demon/half pop-star dawns a Yankee pinstripe jersey, as she wields her signature blade, the Four Tiger Sword. She stands on a Yankees-branded base.

View this post on Instagram

Want to attend in person? Tickets to the game first went on sale through Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, the game may be very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find last-minute New York Yankees tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for the game. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find New York Yankees: KPop Demon Hunters Night Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find New York Yankees Tickets at StubHub

StubHub has all-in pricing , so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for KPop Demon Hunters Night. If not, you’ll get your money back. Additionally, if the game is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit or be offered a full refund without the extra credit. At the time of publishing, New York Yankees tickets start at $27.

EARN REWARDS

Find New York Yankees Tickets at Vivid Seats

Vivid Seats lets you search by type of seat, such as suite, standing room, front of section or the VIP section, while the retailer prioritizes “Super Sellers” who are “experienced, highly rated.” With Vivid Seats, your purchase is protected with the company’s “100% Buyer Guarantee,” which ensures that you receive legitimate tickets in time for the KPop Demon Hunters Night, or your money back.

PROMO CODES

Find New York Yankees Tickets at SeatGeek

Tickets are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. For example, SeatGeek has cheap New York Yankees tickets for KPop Demon Hunters Night online from $27. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

PROMO CODE

Find New York Yankees Tickets at TicketNetwork

And don’t forget TicketNetwork . The retailer has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access and other great experiences. It has tickets to New York Yankees’ KPop Demon Hunters Night with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). Tickets start at $29, as of this writing. You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. The company guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.

Can’t go? The Mariners-Yankees game broadcasts live on TBS, which is available to livestream on DirecTV , Sling Blue , Hulu + Live TV and HBO Max . If you’d like to watch the game for free, DirecTV offers a five-day free trial for its signature packages.
